## identity
cmd: hostname; whoami; echo "SHELL=$SHELL"; getent passwd "$USER" | cut -d: -f6,7; echo "HOME=$HOME"; df -PT "$HOME" | tail -1; stat -f -c "fstype=%T" "$HOME"; grep -E "^(PRETTY_NAME|VERSION_ID)=" /etc/os-release; uname -r; nproc; cat /proc/loadavg
rc=0 ms=63

## sinfo_version
cmd: sinfo --version
rc=0 ms=26

## commands
cmd: for c in squeue sacct sinfo scontrol sshare sprio sstat sacctmgr sbank srun nvidia-smi python3 jq timeout tmux; do printf "%s " "$c"; command -v "$c" || echo MISSING; done; python3 --version 2>&1; jq --version 2>&1
rc=127 ms=79

## scontrol_listpids
cmd: scontrol help 2>&1 | grep -iE "listpids|listjobs|liststeps" ; echo ---; scontrol listpids 2>&1 | head -5
rc=0 ms=46

## slurm_config
cmd: scontrol show config | grep -E "^(ClusterName|SLURM_VERSION|AccountingStorageType|AccountingStorageEnforce|JobAcctGatherType|JobAcctGatherFrequency|MinJobAge|MessageTimeout|PrologFlags|ProctrackType|TaskPlugin|SelectType |SelectTypeParameters|PreemptType|PreemptMode|LaunchParameters|UsePAM|GresTypes|DataParserParameters|SlurmctldParameters|PrivateData|MaxJobCount|SchedulerType) "
rc=0 ms=27

## pam_adopt_login
cmd: grep -l pam_slurm /etc/pam.d/* 2>/dev/null; echo "(login-node pam.d only; compute-node pam not visible)"
rc=0 ms=14

## squeue_me_default
cmd: squeue --me
rc=0 ms=33

## squeue_me_o
cmd: squeue --me -h -o '%i|%j|%T|%M|%l|%D|%R|%b|%C|%m|%P|%V|%S|%Z|%o'
rc=0 ms=33

## squeue_me_O
cmd: squeue --me -h -O 'JobID:|,ArrayJobID:|,ArrayTaskID:|,Name:|,UserName:|,State:|,StateCompact:|,Reason:|,TimeUsed:|,TimeLimit:|,TimeLeft:|,NumNodes:|,NumCPUs:|,MinMemory:|,Partition:|,QOS:|,Account:|,SubmitTime:|,StartTime:|,EndTime:|,NodeList:|,BatchHost:|,tres-alloc:|,tres-per-node:|,tres-per-job:|,RestartCnt:|,STDOUT:|,STDERR:|,WorkDir:|,Command:|'
rc=0 ms=32

## squeue_me_json_size
cmd: squeue --me --json | wc -c
rc=0 ms=37

## squeue_me_json
cmd: squeue --me --json | head -c 400000
rc=0 ms=47

## squeue_parts_O
cmd: squeue -p 'lab,gpu-preempt' -h -O 'JobID:|,ArrayJobID:|,ArrayTaskID:|,Name:|,UserName:|,State:|,StateCompact:|,Reason:|,TimeUsed:|,TimeLimit:|,TimeLeft:|,NumNodes:|,NumCPUs:|,MinMemory:|,Partition:|,QOS:|,Account:|,SubmitTime:|,StartTime:|,EndTime:|,NodeList:|,BatchHost:|,tres-alloc:|,tres-per-node:|,tres-per-job:|,RestartCnt:|,STDOUT:|,STDERR:|,WorkDir:|,Command:|' | head -25
rc=0 ms=35

## squeue_parts_o
cmd: squeue -p 'lab,gpu-preempt' -h -o '%i|%j|%T|%M|%l|%D|%R|%b|%C|%m|%P|%V|%S|%Z|%o' | head -25
rc=0 ms=38

## squeue_parts_states
cmd: squeue -p 'lab,gpu-preempt' -h -o '%T' | sort | uniq -c
rc=0 ms=34

## sacct_basic
cmd: sacct -u $USER -S now-2days -X -P -n --format=JobID,JobName,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,Start,End,NodeList,AllocTRES,Partition,WorkDir
rc=0 ms=33

## sacct_ext
cmd: sacct -u $USER -S now-14days -X -P -n --format=JobID,JobIDRaw,JobName,User,Account,QOS,Partition,State,ExitCode,DerivedExitCode,Reason,Submit,Start,End,Elapsed,Timelimit,AllocCPUS,ReqMem,ReqTRES,AllocTRES,NNodes,NodeList,WorkDir | tail -40
rc=0 ms=69

## sacct_steps
cmd: j=$(sacct -u $USER -S now-14days -X -P -n --format=JobID | tail -1); [ -n "$j" ] && sacct -j "$j" -P -n --format=JobID,JobName,State,ExitCode,Elapsed,MaxRSS,AveCPU,TRESUsageInMax%200
rc=0 ms=72

## sacct_json_size
cmd: sacct -u $USER -S now-2days -X --json | wc -c
rc=0 ms=63

## sinfo_parts

rc=0 ms=32

## sinfo_summary
cmd: sinfo -s
rc=0 ms=34

## scontrol_show_node
cmd: scontrol show node $(scontrol show hostnames 'n-31-01' 2>/dev/null | head -1) -o
rc=0 ms=53

## sacctmgr_assoc
cmd: sacctmgr -n -P show assoc where user=$USER format=Cluster,Account,Partition,QOS,GrpTRES,MaxJobs,MaxSubmit
rc=0 ms=31

## scontrol_partitions
cmd: PARTS_CMD (groups, parent accounts, scontrol show partition -o; fields trimmed to the access/TRES subset)
rc=0 ms=21
